title: Entangled Relay
subtitle: LV, MV and HV, 10% loss
text:
Entangled Relays move FE between every relay on the same code, across any distance and any dimension. Open one and press the button to choose Send or Receive.

A sender takes power from cables and shares it out between the receivers on its code, losing a tenth on the way. A receiver pushes it into the cables or machines next to it.

Each tier moves its own voltage: 1,000 FE/t for LV, 8,000 for MV and 64,000 for HV. Higher voltage blows a relay, and a receiver blows lower rated machines it feeds, like a generator. A private relay only connects to Simple Machines cables you placed yourself.

It uses 8 FE/t and stops relaying without power. Breaking it keeps its code. The relay does not keep chunks loaded.
